description: Read who reacted to or commented on a public post, FRESH at request time. Costs $0.0012 per live read. Set `kind` to reactions or comments and give one of post_id, share_id or post_url. A reactor the network will not name comes back with `hidden: true` and a `person_ref`. A share or ugcPost id alone (its URN, or a /posts/...-share-<id> address) is read through the post's activity; when that cannot be found it answers 404 not_found, free, never an empty page. The last page never holds more than page.total minus start. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged. Limits: no daily cap once the account has topped up; one per-account limit a minute sized to our read pool's live capacity (pricing_get people_reads.rate_limit_per_minute; over it 429 people_read_rate_limit with Retry-After, free); an account on the free signup balance only gets 100 of these reads a day (429 daily_read_limit until 00:00 UTC, free) until its first top-up.

cursor.description: Comments only: opaque cursor from the previous page.

include_replies.description: Comments only: true nests every reply under its comment (up to 100 a comment, with replies_page). Default false. page.total counts replies too when page.total_includes_replies is true.

post_id.description: The post: the post reference the posts read returns (id), its numeric activity id, or its activity, share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.

share_id.description: The post's content id: the share_id the posts read returns, a numeric id, or its share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.
